# vodoo document

Manage Odoo Documents files and folders (requires Odoo Enterprise).

<!-- This file is auto-generated by scripts/gen_cli_docs.py. Do not edit manually. -->

## Commands

### upload

Upload a file to Odoo Documents.

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `file_path` | PATH | Path to the file to upload |

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--folder` / `-f` | TEXT | Destination folder exact name |
| `--folder-id` | INT | Destination folder ID |
| `--tag` | TEXT | Document tag ID or exact name (repeatable) |
| `--owner` | TEXT | Owner user ID, login, or exact name |
| `--name` / `-n` | TEXT | Custom document name (defaults to filename) |

### list

List files in Odoo Documents.

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--folder` / `-f` | TEXT | Filter by folder ID or exact name |
| `--limit` | INT | Maximum number of documents (default: 50) |

### download

Download a file from Odoo Documents.

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `document_id` | INT | Document ID |

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--output` / `-o` | PATH | Output path (defaults to document name) |

### folders

List available Odoo Documents folders.

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--tree` | BOOL | Show hierarchy order, depth, and full path |
| `--limit` | INT | Maximum number of folders (default: 50) |
